summary: Settings feature (Profile → Settings + Timer sync) tested end-to-end. Backend GET/PATCH /api/settings + send_push opt-out filter all pass (9/9). Frontend Profile Settings card renders with both switches; notifications toggle persists across reload; Focus Lock toggle OFF persists and hides the red warning block; Timer banner correctly re-syncs on focus (reads 'Focus Lock is off' muted style when disabled, 'Focus Lock is on' with 60s death warning when enabled). Regression: Profile still shows weekly recap card, stats grid, streak calendar, PayPal freeze card, badges and sign-out without layout breakage. One web-preview-only limitation observed: React-Native-Web's Alert.alert() with a buttons array does NOT render on web, so the 60-second confirmation prompt when re-enabling Focus Lock could not be exercised in the browser preview (works on iOS/Android). The switch stays OFF (safe fallback) when Alert doesn't fire, which is correct behaviour. ui-test-user left with notifications_enabled=true, focus_lock_enabled=true; plant plant_f950c13f4790 untouched. No files modified.
action_items: OPTIONAL — Alert.alert with buttons is a no-op on react-native-web. Since the Profile Settings 'Turn on Focus Lock' confirmation runs through Alert.alert, web users can never re-enable Focus Lock once it is off (the toggle silently snaps back). Consider a custom Modal-based confirm for Platform.OS === 'web' if web preview parity matters; otherwise native iOS/Android behaviour is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py send_push (lines 1204-1225) correctly filters recipients with notifications_enabled=false and no-ops when the resulting list is empty — verified by unit test with a mocked push_http.post.
profile.tsx toggleFocusLock (lines 59-72) short-circuits when turning off (no Alert), and gates the on-switch behind Alert.alert confirmation — semantically correct.
timer.tsx useFocusEffect (lines 69-78) re-fetches /settings on tab focus and updates both lockEnabled state and lockEnabledRef, so the AppState kill path is skipped correctly when disabled.
seed_data_creation: Test file creates ephemeral users prefixed with TEST_ (auto-cleaned in fixtures). ui-test-user settings restored to {notifications_enabled: true, focus_lock_enabled: true} as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings feature verified. Backend endpoints (GET/PATCH /api/settings) and push opt-out are stable. Alert.alert on web is a no-op — do not treat that as a bug unless main agent adds a web Modal fallback.
